title: Coherence criterion for finite constructible sheaves of sets on a vanishing topos
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], let $f:X\to S$ be of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $A$ be a sheaf of sets on the vanishing topos $V_f=X_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow\times_{S_{\mathrm{Et}}}S_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]. Then $A$ is a coherent object of $V_f$ [def-trf-coherent-topos] if and only if there are finite stratifications $X=\coprod_\alpha X_\alpha$ and $S=\coprod_\beta S_\beta$ [def-constructible-stratification], each stratum constructible as a subset [def-weil-constructible-subset], such that for all $\alpha,\beta$ the inverse image of $A$ along the morphism $P_{\alpha\beta}=(X_\alpha)_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow\times_{S_{\mathrm{Et}}}(S_\beta)_{\mathrm{Et}}\to V_f$ given by [lem-trf-oriented-product-universal] from the projections, the stratum immersions and the oriented $2$-morphism is locally constant with finite set values: there is a covering family $(U_i)$ of the final object of $P_{\alpha\beta}$ such that on each slice topos $P_{\alpha\beta}/U_i$ the restricted sheaf is isomorphic to the constant sheaf $\underline{M_i}$ on a finite set $M_i$.

source.place: Author draft, §8.1, printed pp. 17–18, coherence criterion for sheaves of sets on oriented products; finite-presentation Noetherian specialization

proof.text: The hypotheses give the finite-cover triple presentation. Noetherianity and finite presentation imply that S and X are quasi-compact, quasi-separated and Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated] and [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Hence [lem-trf-qcqs-oriented-triple-presentation] presents V_f by a finite-limit site whose covers have finite refinements. The coherent-generator criterion [lem-trf-finitary-site-coherent-generators] applies to this presentation.

source.place: Exposé XI, proof of Lemma 2.5; Orgogozo author draft §8.1, printed p. 17

proof.text: Assume $A$ is coherent; $V_f$ is coherent by step 1. By [lem-trf-finitary-site-coherent-generators] the $H_Z$ generate, so $A$ receives an epimorphism from a coproduct of objects $H_Z$, and since $A$ is quasi-compact [def-trf-coherent-topos] finitely many suffice: $q:F=\coprod_jH_{Z_j}\to A$ is an epimorphism. Each $H_{Z_j}$ is coherent, and $A$ is quasi-separated, so the kernel pair $R=F\times_AF=\coprod_{j,\ell}H_{Z_j}\times_AH_{Z_\ell}$ is quasi-compact, hence receives an epimorphism from a finite coproduct $G=\coprod_kH_{Z'_k}$ of generators. Thus $R$ is the image of $G\to F\times F$ and $A$ is the quotient $F/R$. Every component $U\to X$, $V\to S$, $W\to S$ of the finitely many triples $Z_j,Z'_k$ is separated etale of finite presentation over a qcqs scheme, hence qcqs. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-stratified-finite] to each of these components and take the common refinement of the resulting finitely many partitions of $X$, resp. of $S$; intersections of constructible locally closed subsets are constructible and locally closed [def-weil-constructible-subset], so this gives finite constructible stratifications $X=\coprod_\alpha X_\alpha$, $S=\coprod_\beta S_\beta$ [def-constructible-stratification] with reduced subscheme structures, and every component pulled back to a stratum is finite etale, since finite etale morphisms are stable under base change along $X_\alpha\to X_i$. The strata $X_\alpha,S_\beta$ and the immersions $X_\alpha\to X$, $S_\beta\to S$ and $X_\alpha\to S$ are qcqs, so the base-change clause of [lem-trf-qcqs-oriented-triple-presentation] applies to $a:X_\alpha\to X$, $b=1_S$, $d=g_\beta:S_\beta\to S$ and the induced $u_{\alpha\beta}:P_{\alpha\beta}\to V_f$ of [lem-trf-oriented-product-universal]: $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}H_Z\cong H_{Z_{\alpha\beta}}$ with $Z_{\alpha\beta}=(U_\alpha\to V\leftarrow W_\beta)$, $U_\alpha=U\times_XX_\alpha$, $W_\beta=W\times_SS_\beta$. The explicit formula of [lem-trf-oriented-product-universal] for the identity of $P_{\alpha\beta}$ gives $$H_{Z_{\alpha\beta}}\cong p_1^{-1}H_{U_\alpha}\times_{(g_\beta p_2)^{-1}H_V}p_2^{-1}H_{W_\beta},\qquad (g_\beta p_2)^{-1}H_V=p_2^{-1}H_{V\times_SS_\beta}.$$ Since $U_\alpha\to X_\alpha$, $V\times_SS_\beta\to S_\beta$ and $W_\beta\to S_\beta$ are finite etale, [lem-galois-flc-representable] (1) makes $H_{U_\alpha}$, $H_{V\times_SS_\beta}$, $H_{W_\beta}$ finite locally constant on the quasi-compact schemes $X_\alpha$, $S_\beta$ (a finite subcovering suffices, and the slice of the etale topos at $Y_i$ is $(Y_i)_{\mathrm{Et}}$). Inverse images $p_1^{-1}$, $p_2^{-1}$ preserve epimorphic families onto the final object, slices and constant sheaves, so the three factors are finite locally constant on $P_{\alpha\beta}$, which is presented by a finite-limit site with finite covering families by [lem-trf-qcqs-oriented-triple-presentation]. The finite-limit clause of [lem-trf-finite-locally-constant-coherent] then makes every $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}H_{Z_j}$ and $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}H_{Z'_k}$ finite locally constant, and its coproduct clause makes $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}F$, $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}G$ and $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}F\times u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}F$ finite locally constant. Because $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}$ is exact and preserves colimits, $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}R$ is an internal equivalence relation on $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}F$, it is the image of $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}G\to u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}F\times u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}F$, hence finite locally constant by the image clause, and $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}A\cong u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}F/u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}R$ is finite locally constant by the quotient clause. This is the asserted local constancy with finite values on each $P_{\alpha\beta}$.

source.place: Author draft §8.1, printed pp. 17–18, coherence criterion and its finite constructible refinement

proof.text: Conversely, let finite constructible stratifications with finite locally constant restrictions be given, and let $u:\coprod_{\alpha,\beta}P_{\alpha\beta}\to V_f$ be the coproduct of the maps $u_{\alpha\beta}$. By [lem-trf-stratified-product-coherent-conservative] $u$ is coherent and conservative. Each $P_{\alpha\beta}$ is presented by a finite-limit site with finite covering families by the qcqs case of [lem-trf-qcqs-oriented-triple-presentation] (the strata and their maps to $S$ are qcqs), so it is coherent by [lem-trf-finitary-site-coherent-generators]; its final object is quasi-compact, so each given covering family $(U_i)$ has a finite subfamily, and $u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}A$ is finite locally constant in the sense of [lem-trf-finite-locally-constant-coherent], hence coherent. An object of the finite coproduct topos is coherent exactly when each component is, so $u^{-1}A=(u_{\alpha\beta}^{-1}A)_{\alpha\beta}$ is coherent, and $V_f$ is coherent by step 1. Applying [lem-trf-coherent-conservative-reflection] to $u$ yields that $A$ is coherent.

lean.statement: theorem coherent_iff_finite_constructible_strata {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [CompactSpace S] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (A : VanishingTopos.{u, v} f) : IsCoherentObject.{max (u + 1) v} A ↔ ∃ (SX : Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X) (SS : Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification S), (∀ i : Fin SX.n, Topology.IsConstructible (SX.stratum i)) ∧ (∀ j : Fin SS.n, Topology.IsConstructible (SS.stratum j)) ∧ ∀ (i : Fin SX.n) (j : Fin SS.n) (U : ProductSite.{u, v} (SX.immersion i ≫ f) (SS.immersion j ≫ 𝟙 S)), ∃ R : Sieve U, R ∈ productTopology (SX.immersion i ≫ f) (SS.immersion j ≫ 𝟙 S) U ∧ ∀ (V : ProductSite.{u, v} (SX.immersion i ≫ f) (SS.immersion j ≫ 𝟙 S)) (r : V ⟶ U), R r → ∃ (M : Type (max (u + 1) v)), Finite M ∧ Nonempty (((orientedStratumSetRestriction f (SX.immersion i) (SS.immersion j)).obj A).over V ≅ ((constantSheaf (productTopology (SX.immersion i ≫ f) (SS.immersion j ≫ 𝟙 S)) (Type (max (u + 1) v))).obj M).over V)
lean.note: The input is the recorded VanishingTopos. The canonical set inverse image uses the published vanishingNormalization followed by the published stratumBaseChange and sheafified left Kan extension. The finite locally constant clause is written out using covering sieves and slice sheaf isomorphisms; no new local-constancy predicate is introduced.
